forms:
I’ve decided to give this social media thing a whirl.
Today’s my first go at it!

Why? To bring in new recruits for our organization!

We may not be the heroes of the story as far as most
people out there are concerned. To be completely
honest, we’re kinda the villains!

But if you forget about all the rules and common
sense and stuff, we live how we wanna live...

and I think that makes us a pretty fun organization!

Since we don’t have the best reputation, I can’t really
give out our name...

But it’s kinda hard to talk about it without a name, so
uh...let’s go with Team R! Got it?

So anyway, give me a yell if you’re interested in being
a member of Team R!

We managed to track down the renowned Kenzo,
owner of the largest building in the area, for a
special interview!

“My family has dreamed of constructing a building
here for generations,” said a tearful Kenzo, with
Machamp by his side. Machamp had also helped
with the construction.

Read on for the interview covering this man’s
remarkable life! (Average reading time: 4.5 hours)

Team R is building a top-secret warehouse!

I went to help out a bit today and got covered in
sand. It kinda sucked!

A bunch of smart-looking people were there too, like
scientists and engineers and all that. It kinda freaked
me out.

But it’s pretty cool that our boss has so many different
people on call like that!

Team R was actually really infamous in Kanto back in
the day, but our boss at the time disbanded the whole
organization. Our new boss restarted things, and now
we’re back!

I really respect our current boss! We’re all baddies
and villains, but he totally gets us!

I’m gonna be his loyal underling forever!

One good thing and one bad thing happened to
me today.

The good thing was that I got assigned to a special
mission by the boss!

Our boss really knows how to pick people for special
missions. If I can do well on this, I’ll climb the ranks to
exec in no time! Maybe!

The bad thing is that the mission itself...

seems really hard and kinda annoying!

He wants me to gather all kinds of things. In a time
like this?! Food, furniture, uhhh...what else? Anyway,
just LOTS of stuff.

I’m just a little grunt and don’t have any underlings of
my own, so it’s a big ask!

I’m just trying to figure out the absolute easiest,
low-energy way to complete this mission!

Let me tell you all about what happened while I was
looking for Leppa Berries to try and complete this
mission for the boss.

There’s been a bunch of extreme weather or whatever
recently that’s killing off all the trees, but I FINALLY
found a tree that still had berries on it!

But as soon as I started shaking the tree to get the
berries off, some super serious-looking lady came
up and started yelling at me!

She was like, “Those are NOT for you! They’re for
Pokémon! There are already FAR too few berries!”

Blah blah blah. She was so annoying! But something
else she said was actually kinda interesting...

Apparently she’s making an app or something to get
a bunch of people to work together and create a
comfortable environment for Pokémon to live in.

Basically, if you do good stuff for the environment...

the app will reward you with cool prizes!

In other words, she’s gonna bribe people to work for
her by promising ’em cool stuff. Not a bad idea!

And that gave ME a GREAT idea!

I bet I could complete that mission the boss gave me
by doing kind of the same thing!

So I went ahead and got some prizes ready.

I went with Gym Badges! People are crazy about those
things, y’know? These are fake ones, though!

Now I just gotta get some nice little Pokémon Trainers
to come work for free!

But that’s got me kinda stumped. All the Trainers I try
to talk to in town just look at me like I’m suspicious
and ignore everything I say.

I dunno if my handiwork was no good or if I just have
a face that only a mother could trust, but I gotta say
that this whole thing’s got me feeling kinda down.

I even had to report to the boss and tell him that the
mission wasn’t going well. I just didn’t have a choice.

But the boss didn’t get mad! He just gave me a pep
talk and even let me in on some ultra-top-secret intel
about our warehouse!

The Secret of Team R’s Warehouse!!!

Of course I can’t spill all the beans...but I can spill
some of ’em!

You’ve probably heard the rumors about having all
the humans evacuate into outer space. Well! Our boss
tells me that the rumors are true!

But apparently they don’t want Team R doing bad
stuff in outer space, so they’re gonna split us up...

and send us all to different areas! Not cool, people.
I can’t be the only one who thinks that’s not cool!

But our boss has us covered.

Turns out that warehouse is ACTUALLY Team R’s
secret weapon for getting us into outer space
together! I cried happy tears! Our boss rules!

How are we gonna get to outer space on our own,
you ask? Well...I can’t tell ya that! Haha!

Hearing about the boss’s dream of keeping Team R
together even in outer space really got me motivated.
I’m gonna give my mission one more serious go!

I did a little work on the rocke—uh, the warehouse—
to trick people walking by into wanting to help out
with my mission.

It was a LOT of work, but I just had to keep in mind
that I was working hard in the moment so I could take
it easy later! Not a bad way to do things, I think!

The engineers all looked kinda annoyed with me,
but they did lend me a hand.

Now all I gotta do is wait for some goody-goody
to come along and do my mission for me!

I’m gonna go ahead and report to the boss what
I’ve accomplished. I bet he’ll be so proud!

Account suspended due to policy violations.

The owner of this account was found to belong to the
criminal organization calling themselves “Team R,”
which has been causing trouble across the region.

The entire organization, including its boss, has been
apprehended by the International Police. We hope
that this news will allow our users to continue using
our platform with peace of mind.

The damage caused by recent meteorological
anomalies is immense and dreadful.

The news is continuously reporting on all manner
of disasters affecting regions all over the world.
There’s even speculation that global food and energy
resources may become insufficient if this continues.

At university, I researched methods for creating
comfortable environments for Pokémon and humans.
There must be something I can do in this crisis...

I have decided to do whatever I can—no matter
how small. Therefore, I have begun creating homes
for Pokémon who lost theirs due to natural disasters.

I don’t know how much this is helping the world at
large, but the Pokémon, at least, seem to be grateful
for the work I’m doing.

I hope to continue my efforts until the meteorological
anomalies calm down.

Like-minded individuals have been slowly joining my
cause as I continue to create homes for Pokémon.

I greatly appreciate the support those individuals
provide, but we have all begun to grow tired as the
meteorological anomalies and resulting natural
disasters continue to worsen.

We need more time, and we need more help.

I have recently begun hearing rumors that there
are plans to temporarily evacuate all of humanity
into space.

If these rumors are true, does that mean that all of
our efforts have been in vain?

My collaborators seem anxious as well. Perhaps they
are of the same mind as I...

I had a truly surprising experience today.

Someone from an influential foundation in another
region visited us and offered to back our efforts here.

This foundation is dedicated to Pokémon care and
conservation, and they have promised to provide us
with everything we need. I cannot think of a more
perfect collaborator to join our cause.

With their support, I may finally be able to...

More and more people are finding themselves low on
sleep recently due to the rapid and unexpected
changes in their environment.

In this issue, we’ll offer some ideas that can help to
get your sleep back on track, including information
on aromatherapy and hot baths. Better sleep at night
starts with a more relaxing day!

realize the dream I’ve had for ages.

My dream: to foster a society in which the majority
of people—not only my team—are interested and
invested in creating comfortable environments for
Pokémon and humans to live in.

That goal always seemed far too lofty and out of
reach, but I believe it has now entered the realm of
possibility with the strong support the foundation has
promised us.

We have developed an app that will allow all
members of our society to participate in creating a
comfortable environment for Pokémon and humans.

The budget and staff required to accomplish this feat
were provided by the foundation, and the app can be
accessed by anyone via Pokémon Center PC.

Participants can start with easy tasks, such as watering
dry ground or planting the seeds of various plants—

anything that will please nearby Pokémon. The app
will reward the participant with virtual “coins,” which
can in turn be exchanged for a variety of prizes.

This was my first time developing an app, and it was
quite the challenge. However, with the help of many
talented collaborators, we finally succeeded.

The name of the app is Poké Life.

In a most unfortunate turn of events, Poké Life never
received a chance to be put to use.

The drastic deterioration of the global environment
continues, and the plan to evacuate all of humanity
into space has finally been put into action.

Efforts have begun to gather as many Pokémon as
possible from all over the world and send them into
the Pokémon Center system for safekeeping.

I was unable to make my dream a reality, but there is
at least one silver lining in all of this.

Even after we humans leave this planet, the Pokémon
Center system will remain active in order to keep all
of the Pokémon inside safe.

The system will also keep a record of environmental
data around each Pokémon Center. The framework
we developed for Poké Life will be used for this.

The recorded data will be analyzed by research teams
set to return from space at regular intervals.

They say this is how we will determine when it’s safe
for all of humanity to return to the planet together.

My time here is short. I must soon go to space myself.

My new dream will be of the day when humans and
Pokémon can once again live together on this planet.
